content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Messaging App Is Not Installed ## slug: msg-ss-messaging-apps-not-installed ## seoTitle: Messaging App Is Not Installed ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ### Scheduler Admin If the BT Messaging App is not installed in your Salesforce org, a warning message tells the user to install the app in the Global Scheduler. ![MessagingAppNotInstalled_1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/MessagingAppNotInstalled_1.png){height="" width=""} If the BT Messaging App is not installed in your Salesforce org, a warning message tells the user to install the app in the Event Record Page Scheduler. ![MessagingAppNotInstalled_2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/MessagingAppNotInstalled_2.jpg){height="" width=""} ### Scheduler User The Scheduler User does not have access to the Administration Settings. When they land on the Record Level Scheduler, a warning message tells them to contact the System Administrator. ![MessagingAppNotInstalled_3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/MessagingAppNotInstalled_3.jpg){height="" width=""}
